name: lolPing Lite
description: Send LOL pings and emotes over your desktop and other app windows, adapted from darrenprx/lolPing.
releaseNotes: Redesign settings with six horizontal categories, DBX theme colors and neutral buttons. Edit ping and emote wheels visually: select a direction, assign a resource and swap occupied slots; preview remains a separate action. Add emote search and retain image/audio imports and the offline pack download entry. Keep start, pause/resume and save status accessible, with responsive layouts and Chinese/English text. Only DBX plugin capabilities are shown; no autostart or tray settings. The overlay remains natively rendered; Windows now clears a remaining corner-clipping region after display, raise or geometry changes. Global gestures, the earlier screen-edge fix and existing user data remain compatible. Settings continue to use DBX's existing UI container; this update makes no new memory-reduction claim.
